GQFINITE20261114.title: Finite quadratic Gaussian classification and sharp mixed cutoff
GQFINITE20261114.scope: For every centered complex quadratic P=X^T A X+l^T X-tr(A) in Gaussian covariance rank N>=1, with A symmetric, the first 2N+1 zero pure moments imply A^N=0 and l^T A^j l=0 for 0<=j<N. Conversely these identities imply all positive pure moments vanish, and E(QP^m)=0 for m>floor(N/2) deg(Q). The local source audits Liu v3 Theorems 2.1 and 2.2 and gives explicit circular chains attaining this mixed bound in every rank N>=2 and every multiplier degree. The optimality of the pure threshold 2N+1 in all ranks is reported separately from Liu and is outside this registered local proof audit. Rank zero is deterministic; rank one admits only the zero moment-null quadratic. The checker verifies finite examples independently, not the universal classification or realization theorem.

GQINPUT20261114.title: Input-sensitive quadratic Gaussian mixed cutoff
GQINPUT20261114.scope: For a classified moment-null quadratic in covariance rank N>=1, let nu>=1 be the nilpotency index of A (nu=1 for A=0), and s=dim span{l,Al,...} (s=0 for l=0). Every multiplier Q of degree d satisfies E(QP^m)=0 for m>s*d+floor(d/2)*max(0,nu-1-2*s). The bound follows by maximizing the Wick partition degree from the polynomial tilted mean and covariance, is at most floor(N/2)d, and is not asserted optimal for each input. GQ3NORMAL20261114.title: Complete ternary quadratic Gaussian moment-null normal form
GQ3NORMAL20261114.scope: Every complex polynomial of degree at most two in three standard real Gaussian variables with all positive pure moments zero has, in a complex orthogonal circular frame, the form P=Z*(a*Z+b*T+c), with E(ZW)=E(T^2)=1 and the other pairings zero. GCOMPACTALL20261114.title: Mathieu property for all compact Lie groups via component trace separation
GCOMPACTALL20261114.scope: For any compact Lie group G, connected or disconnected, the kernel of normalized Haar integration on its complex representative-function algebra is Mathieu--Zhao if and only if the identity component G^0 is abelian, equivalently a torus including the trivial torus. Restriction to the finitely many components identifies the algebra and functional with a product of representative-function algebras and their equal Haar average; zero extension is finite-type by the explicit finite-index induced-representation construction. For toral identity component GVC2FTS forces componentwise pure moment vanishing, and Duistermaat--van der Kallen gives a common eventual mixed cutoff over the finite component set. For nonabelian identity component, zero extension of Longs connected witness retains its nonzero mixed moments up to the component-index factor. This internally written deduction closes the virtually toral remainder described in Liu 21689760 v2.2s public record. It makes no priority claim, does not use that papers unaudited proof and does not cover non-Lie compact groups or minimal witness degree. Independent finite checks cover the opposite-component support example and the retained digit-separation regression, not all Lie theory.
dependencies: external: Duistermaat--van der Kallen constant-term theorem

G3AFFINEW20261114.title: All-degree affine-W ternary Gaussian pure-moment classification
G3AFFINEW20261114.scope: For P=W*h(Z)+v(Z)*T^2+u(Z)*T+r(Z) with arbitrary complex univariate polynomial coefficients and circular Wick pairings E(ZW)=E(T^2)=1, all positive pure moments vanish exactly in three branches. If h(0)=0, h is divisible by Z^2 and v,u,r by Z, giving strictly one-sided support and GMC safety. If h=a!=0 is constant, v=0 and r=-Z*u^2/(2a), giving a polynomial Gaussian triangular shear and GMC safety. If h=a+bZ with a*b!=0, v=(h-h^3/a^2)/(2Z), u=h^2*k and r=-(a^2/2)*Z*h*k^2 for an arbitrary polynomial k; then E(Z*P^m)=m!*a*b^(m-1) for every m>=1, so every member fails GMC. No higher-degree h with nonzero constant term is possible: its reduced logarithmic-derivative numerator has a root off h, contradicting the forced polynomial square identity. The proof uses GL1 and rational-exponential rigidity; exact finite regressions test both charts and nonconstant repaired failures, not the universal quantifiers. No global ternary classification or novelty claim.

G3AFFINEWCUBIC20261114.title: Complete twelve-coefficient cubic Gaussian chart and sufficient twelve-moment gate
G3AFFINEWCUBIC20261114.scope: In the G3AFFINEW20261114 architecture impose deg h<=2, deg v<=1, deg u<=2 and deg r<=3. All moment-null members are either the strictly one-sided zero branch or P=aW+(c+dZ)T-Z*(c+dZ)^2/(2a), a!=0. Thus this entire twelve-coefficient cubic subarchitecture satisfies GMC and contains no counterexample. Its first twelve pure moments suffice: on h(0)!=0 the rational logarithmic-derivative numerator after t=z/h(z) has degree at most eleven, and on h(0)=0 the numerator has degree at most three, so four moments already suffice there. Twelve is sufficient, not asserted optimal. The omitted monomials are W^2,W^3,W^2Z,W^2T,WT,WZT,WT^2,T^3; they are not proved removable by a change of frame. The global dense ternary cubic question remains open.

G3SHEARCUTOFF20261114.title: Sharp mixed Gaussian cutoff for all polynomial triangular shears
G3SHEARCUTOFF20261114.scope: For P=aW+u(Z)T-Z*u(Z)^2/(2a), a!=0, and u of degree j>=1 with leading coefficient c, every monomial multiplier Z^i W^l T^k has zero mixed moment for m>i+(2j+1)l+(j+1)k. Hence m>(2j+1)*deg Q suffices for every polynomial Q. This coefficient is sharp in this family: E(W^d*P^((2j+1)d))=((2j+1)d)!*(-c^2*a^(2j-1)/2)^d is nonzero for every d>=1. A full source generating identity proves both claims. Constant u gives an isotropic linear form with the degree-Q cutoff. This quantifies the Gaussian-preserving shear already present in the sparse Pareto theorem; it does not claim a new shear mechanism or a uniform all-cubic theorem.

G3AFFINEWFINITE20261114.title: Effective finite pure-moment gate and complete quartic affine-W locus
G3AFFINEWFINITE20261114.scope: For architecture P=W*h(Z)+v(Z)*T^2+u(Z)*T+r(Z) of total degree at most D>=2, the first 5D-3 zero pure moments imply all positive pure moments vanish. On h(0)!=0, after t=z/h(z), the rational logarithmic-derivative numerator has degree at most 5D-4 and a unit denominator at zero. On h(0)=0, its numerator has degree at most three, so four moments already suffice in every degree. These are sufficient bounds, with no optimality claim. In degree at most four the complete sixteen-coefficient family has failures exactly h=a+bZ, a*b!=0, v=(h-h^3/a^2)/(2Z), u=h^2*(k0+k1*Z), r=-(a^2/2)*Z*h*(k0+k1*Z)^2. The other two pure-null branches are GMC-safe; every safe quartic in this architecture has mixed vanishing for m>3*deg Q, sharply in the shear subfamily. The universal conclusions are written rational-function and degree proofs; finite checks do not provide an exhaustive polynomial search.

G3HEIGHT20261114.title: Complete cubic-height Gaussian classification via formal Airy--Riccati obstruction
G3HEIGHT20261114.scope: For P=W*h(Z)+s(Z)*T^3+v(Z)*T^2+u(Z)*T+r(Z) with arbitrary complex univariate polynomial coefficients and E(ZW)=E(T^2)=1, all positive pure moments zero force s=0 whenever h(0)!=0. The preceding complete affine-W classification then applies. On h(0)=0, pure vanishing is equivalent to h divisible by Z^2 and s,v,u,r divisible by Z, giving strictly one-sided support and GMC safety. In particular the entire thirteen-coefficient cubic family has s=0 on its pure-null locus and contains no GMC failure. In quartic degree the extended family has eighteen coefficients; its failures are precisely the preceding linear-h, linear-repair family with s=0. The proof derives a formal cubic-Gaussian two-by-two differential system, proves that rational logarithmic derivative would give an algebraic Airy Riccati solution, and excludes algebraic solutions by finite-point ODE uniqueness, Riemann--Hurwitz and rational behavior at infinity. It does not use a singular change of integration contour. The checker proves the universal rational identities and separately tests finite Wick regressions; formalization and external review remain absent. No general ternary frame reduction is claimed.

G3HEIGHTFINITE20261114.title: Uniform finite pure-moment gate for cubic-height affine-W architecture
G3HEIGHTFINITE20261114.scope: For P=W*h(Z)+s(Z)*T^3+v(Z)*T^2+u(Z)*T+r(Z) of total degree at most D>=3, the first 19D-22 zero pure moments imply all positive pure moments vanish. On h(0)!=0 and s!=0, the scalar differential equation from the cubic-Gaussian system has, after multiplication by h^6*(Z*s)^7, polynomial coefficient degrees at most 13D-20,13D-19,13D-18. The rational residual for the required target H*exp(-R) has a nonzero numerator of degree at most 19D-24 and a denominator that is a unit at zero. A 19D-22 zero prefix forces a larger zero order, a contradiction. The h(0)=0, s(0)!=0 scalar curve satisfies the same estimates; s(0)=0 reduces to the four-moment quadratic scalar gate. Once cubic height disappears on the moving branch, use the existing 5D-3 gate. Thus 35 moments suffice for the thirteen-coefficient cubic family and 54 for the eighteen-coefficient quartic family, without an optimality claim. Universal degree estimates and no-algebraic-Riccati exclusion are written proofs; generic numeric-coefficient degree checks are regressions only.

GQSHARP20261114.title: Liu all-rank sharp quadratic pure-moment threshold audit
GQSHARP20261114.scope: The least initial pure-moment threshold for complex quadratic polynomials in Gaussian covariance rank N>=1 is exactly 2N+1. Sufficiency is GQFINITE20261114. Necessity follows from a complete written audit of Liu 21688251 v3: the N-1 weighted logarithmic-gap equations pull back to positive-degree homogeneous equations in N variables, so Krull height gives nonzero data with D!=1. A self-adjoint Hankel realization of the strictly proper rational part, a nilpotent realization of the polynomial part and zero-vector blocks for unused determinant factors realize every D(0)=1, deg D<=N, deg B<N in at most N dimensions, including repeated roots and degree drop. The gap truncation yields 2N vanishing moments; the finite theorem forces the next one nonzero. Coefficients can be algebraic. Independent exact checks exhibit ranks one and two, including an actual ordinary symmetric two-dimensional Gaussian polynomial with first four zero moments and fifth 2*(5delta-1)!=0 for 6delta^2-6delta+1=0. The all-rank existence proof is not an enumerated all-rank certificate; no Catalan point-count or priority claim is made.

G3LINEARWT20261114.title: Complete affine-linear W-coefficient cubic face and the mixed WT/WZ2 gate
G3LINEARWT20261114.scope: Every pure-moment-zero polynomial P=W*(a+bZ+cT)+G(Z,T), deg G<=3, satisfies GMC. For c!=0 the full homogeneous cubic part G3 is zero: GL1 gives g=at/(1-bt)+ct/(1-bt)*T, and the scalar cubic-Gaussian coefficient is t*G3(ct/(1-bt),1). The formal Airy--Riccati obstruction forces this rational function to vanish; its argument is nonconstant, hence G3=0 and the polynomial is quadratic. The c=0 face is the preceding closed cubic-height architecture, including a=0. A coarse sufficient 92-moment pure gate follows from the general residual degree table using denominator (1-bt)^3, coefficient numerators of degree at most four, target j=(1-bt)^4 and bound parameter six; the residual numerator has degree at most 90. Ninety-two is not asserted optimal. Consequently a failure in the declared fourteen-coefficient family W*(a+bZ+dZ^2+cT)+G(Z,T), deg G<=3, must have c*d!=0. This conditional family statement does not normalize arbitrary cubics or exclude WZT,WT^2 or higher W powers. Exact regressions compare the moving real-coordinate fixed point with direct Wick expansion; the exclusion is a written all-order proof.

G3MIXEDPHASE20261114.scope: For P=W*(a+bZ+dZ^2+cT)+G(Z,T), deg G<=3 and c*d!=0, Gaussian-preserving null rotation, scalar multiplication and diagonal orthogonal scaling normalize the family to W*(alpha+T+Z^2)+G with arbitrary alpha and all ten G coefficients retained. G3MIXEDSPINE20261114.scope: For every complex a,A,B,C,S, P=W*(a+T+Z^2)+A*Z^3+B*Z^2*T+C*Z*T^2+S*T^3 has at least one nonzero positive pure Gaussian moment among the first eight. G3WZTFINITE20261114.title: All-degree finite conic gates and complete cubic WZT family
G3WZTFINITE20261114.scope: For cubic P=W*(a+bZ+cT+dZ^2+eZT+fT^2)+G(Z,T), deg G<=3, the nondegenerate e^2-4df!=0 locus has a nonzero pure moment among the first 888. When f=0,e!=0, 447 suffice. In Laurent conic coordinates the rank is at most six and t^5*Phi has coefficient degree<=6; in the WZT and retained trapped-component models t^2*Phi has degree<=3. Logarithmic connection reduction gives N/H with numerator and denominator degrees B<=L*(r+1), L=6 or3. Minimal-seed cofactors bound scalar coefficients by B*s*(s+1)/2, and the nonzero zeroth coefficient gives prefixes 888 and447 at r<=6. These are sufficient bounds, not optimality claims or moment expansions through the claimed prefixes. Thus the complete fifteen-coefficient family f=0 satisfies GMC, with 447 initial zero moments implying all-order pure vanishing: e!=0 is excluded and e=0 is the existing fourteen-coefficient family with gate320. For the full sixteen-coefficient W-linear cubic family this result reduces the then-remaining analysis to candidates with f!=0,e^2-4df=0, and a Gaussian null rotation reduces it to W*(a+bZ+cT+fT^2)+G. This rank-one family includes the GMC-safe pure-null polynomial W*T^2 and is not excluded by the theorem. The subsequent G3WTRANKONE20261114 and G3WLINEAR20261114 complete that rank-one classification and GMC safety. Higher W powers and a global frame reduction remain open. More generally for deg G<=D, D>=3, a sufficient nonzero prefix on the nondegenerate quadratic-W locus is 2D^2*(2D+1)^2+2D, and on f=0,e!=0 is D^2*(2D+1)^2+2D. The general Laurent phase has t-pole order<=2D-1 and coefficient numerator degree<=2D after clearing, or D-1 and D on the WZT face, with rank<=2D. The same connection/cofactor proof gives the formulas. These all-degree statements exclude delta!=0 only and do not assert all-degree GMC safety on the degenerate boundary, which already contains quartic failures. G3WTRANKONE20261114.title: Complete rank-one WT2 cubic pure-null classification and sufficient 425-moment gate
G3WTRANKONE20261114.scope: For P=W*(a+bZ+cT+fT^2)+G(Z,T), f!=0 and deg G<=3, all positive pure Gaussian moments vanish if and only if b=0 and G=0. Thus its pure-null members are W*(a+cT+fT^2) and satisfy E(QP^m)=0 for m>deg Q. Conditional GL1 gives g=t*A(T)/(1-bt). At b=0, highest Z degree of G yields a dominant polynomial phase and shrinking zero-action periods; the only degree-drop escape and the linear-G0 Gaussian escape have nonzero actions. At b!=0 divide G by bZ+A(T), with quotient linear and remainder R0(Z)+T*R1(Z). The remainder restricts triangularly to all T-degrees0..6, permitting complete stable/escape analysis. The exceptional alpha=beta=0,gamma=-b/(2f) quadratic limit is handled exactly: its coefficient is -1/(2q), and the constant-restriction Gaussian period is q^(-1/2)*exp(H), whose logarithmic derivative has residue -1/2. No nonzero constant period occurs off b=0,G=0. The analytic shrinking and period-comparison argument is written, not a computational contour certificate. Rational-connection numerator/denominator degrees are at most4d+4 for phase degree d<=6; minimal-seed cofactors give the sufficient pure prefix425. No optimality, external review, formalization or arbitrary-cubic frame reduction is claimed. G3WLINEAR20261114.title: Complete sixteen-coefficient W-linear cubic GMC theorem and sharp mixed cutoff
G3WLINEAR20261114.scope: Every pure-null polynomial P=W*(a+bZ+cT+dZ^2+eZT+fT^2)+G(Z,T), deg G<=3, satisfies GMC. This is the complete sixteen-coefficient W-linear cubic family. Nondegenerate e^2-4df!=0 is excluded by the logarithmic conic theorem; f=0 is the completed fifteen-coefficient family; f!=0 on the degenerate discriminant is reduced by a Gaussian null rotation to G3WTRANKONE20261114. The sufficient initial pure-moment gates are888,447,425 respectively, so888 suffices for all-order pure vanishing in the whole family. Every pure-null member has E(QP^m)=0 for m>3*deg Q, sharply by the previously registered cubic Gaussian shear; the new rank-one products and the one-sided/quadratic branches need only m>deg Q. There is an exact coordinate-free frame criterion: for P=F3+F2+F1+F0, a Gaussian W-linear frame exists if and only if a nonzero vector v satisfies B(v,v)=0, grad F3(v)=0 and F2(v)=0, since D_v^2P(x)=2 grad F3(v) dot x+2F2(v). Thus any global cubic GMC failure must have that projective intersection empty. No proof establishes that all pure-null cubics meet the criterion. W^2,W^3,W^2Z,W^2T and the empty-intersection case remain outside the theorem. Internal written period proofs and exact algebra checks have no external review or formal verification. G3DEGREEMIN20261115.title: Global minimal degree and dimension of Gaussian-moment failures at the cubic boundary
G3DEGREEMIN20261115.scope: Degree4 is the globally least possible degree of a three-variable GMC failure, and four independent Gaussian coordinates are the least possible dimension of a cubic GMC failure. G3FRAMEDET20261115.title: Exact determinantal frame test for every ternary cubic
G3FRAMEDET20261115.scope: For any complex polynomial of total degree<=3 in three standard Gaussian coordinates, a Gaussian W-linear frame exists iff the following rational8-by16 matrix has rank<8. In circular coordinates with B(v,v)=2vZ*vW+vT^2, parametrize its null conic by v=(s^2,-t^2/2,st). Restrict partial_Z F3,partial_W F3,partial_T F3 and F2 to v, giving four binary quartics. The matrix represents S3^4->S7 by multiplication by these forms. A common root annihilates its image; if no common root exists, two generic linear combinations are coprime quartics, and their degree7 multiplication map is an isomorphism. This proves the rank equivalence in all specializations, including zero forms, repeated roots and projective endpoints. There are12870 maximal minors of degree8 in the16 quadratic/cubic coefficients. A homogeneous gcd is an exact cheaper per-input test; a frame over C need not be defined over the input number field. This is solely the algebraic frame condition, not a pure-null criterion. It uses the retained directional-derivative/frame identity, without any analytic period argument. The checker verifies universal conic/derivative/matrix-size identities and ten specialized gcd/rank cases with nonzero maximal-minor witnesses where no frame exists. G3ODDPURE20261115.title: Complete odd ternary cubic pure-null normal form and sharp mixed cutoff deg Q

Positive circular weight proves E(QP^m)=0 for m>deg Q; coefficient1 is sharp even for genuine cubics via P=Z*T^2,Q=W^D and value D!*(2D-1)!!. This sharpens the general mixed3*deg-Q bound only on the odd subclass.
